question: Which of the following vitamins is also known as riboflavin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin B-2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin B-2** is known as **Riboflavin**. Vitamin B-2 is one of the 8 vitamins help the body to convert food (carbohydrates) into fuel (glucose), which is used to produce energy.
 
• These also help the body** metabolize fats and protein**.
 
• B complex vitamins are necessary for a **healthy liver, skin, hair, and eyes**.
 
• They also help the **nervous system function properly**.
 
• Sources of Vitamin B-2: Dairy milk, Yogurt, Cheese, Eggs, Whole grains, Wheat germ, Wild rice, Mushrooms, Broccoli, Brussels sprouts, Spinach and Soybeans.
 
• Deficiency of Vitamin B-2 can lead to - fatigue, swollen throat, blurred vision, depression, skin crack, itching, and dermatitis around the mouth. Hyperemia and edema around the throat, liver degeneration, hair loss and reproductive issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin B-12**:

 
 
• Vitamin B-12 is a water-soluble vitamin, also known as **Cobalamins** because vitamin B12 contains the mineral cobalt.
 
• It is required for the overall development, myelination, and function of the central nervous system; healthy red blood cell formation; and DNA synthesis.
 
• Sources - **fish, meat, poultry, eggs, and dairy products**.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin B-6:**
 
 
• Vitamin B-6 is a water-soluble vitamin that helps in disease prevention.**​**
 
• Sources - **Tuna, Salmon, Fortified cereals, Chickpeas and Poultry**.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin B-1**:
 
 
• Vitamin B1also known as **thiamin** or **thiamine**, enables the body to use carbohydrates as energy. It is necessary for glucose metabolism, and has a key role to play in proper functioning of the nerve, muscle, and heart.
 
• Sources- **peas, fresh fruits, nuts, wholegrain bread, cereals, liver**.
